note: Build with your kids: the labs section under Builds (docs/research/kids-stem-section-proposal-2026-10-17.md). One entry per lab: the level, the payoff in a child's words, why it is cool, the project it points at (site/data/projects.json slug; its tested boards decide the status word), the grown-up's part, a session length (an estimate until one child is timed) and the safety line. Rendered by tools/render_kids.py to site/kids.html. A lab shows as ready only when its project ran on a board; otherwise it says what still has to run. No accounts, no forms for children, no analytics. The second typeface and the two warm colors are not in use yet; until then the skin is Barlow at a larger size on the site's own colors.

labs.why: You tell the chip how to blink, and it does exactly that, every time.
labs.note: In the Digital Lab the grown-up plugs the board in and the child picks the colors and times from the page; no code.

labs.payoff: Draw a number, the chip guesses
labs.why: A chip the size of a fingernail reads your handwriting.
labs.note: The grown-up builds it ahead of time; the child only draws.

labs.payoff: Fade a light, like a dimmer
labs.why: The chip switches so fast the light looks dimmer instead of blinking.
Your first input and your first output on one board.
Eleven wires, one screen, and your own drawings on it.
labs.safety: USB power only. Check the twelve wires against the card before power.

labs.why: You wire the screen and load the model; then it reads your writing.
Real sensors on a plug-in board, numbers you can change by hand.
The board has a thermistor; warm it with a finger and watch.

labs.payoff: The chip hears an alarm tone
labs.why: A small board learns a sound and tells you when it hears it.
labs.safety: Low volume. A real smoke alarm test is grown-up only.

labs.why: Analog in: a knob becomes a number on the screen.
labs.safety: USB power only; 3.3 V on the pins, never 5 V.

labs.payoff: Tiny networks decide if a room is busy
labs.why: You time a model on the chip and check it against the test set.

labs.payoff: Build and flash in one command
labs.why: No window, no clicks: the way engineers do it.
